objective: Freeze a publication-auditable Path-C boundary in which candidate, strongest-zero and same-coordinate-bit receive the identical 214912-byte external capacity charge while compute-island logic remains separately measured. This contract creates no RTL, external-memory implementation, DC/PT/SAIF/PTPX result, area, timing, power or energy number.

frozen_raw_cpu_opportunity.scope: frozen H67 four bottleneck Conv, raw CPU same-ledger replay only

conservative_residual_common_charge.permitted_label: identical conservative external capacity common charge [model]

three_axis_identity.reason: The resource and technology model is common; actual address-timed accesses may differ and must be charged with the same coefficients rather than erased.

included: candidate matcher, parent-capture control and response queue when present
excluded: all external common-charge storage macro area
all external common-charge dynamic access energy
logic_only_dc.paper_label: 28-nm pre-route logic-only DC; external 214912-byte common charge excluded

legal_remedies: rerun matched logic-only tops with all storage macros outside the measured boundary
or subtract a separately sealed exact parent-macro area/leakage/dynamic contribution before adding the common external charge
no_double_count.required_check: For every physical storage instance or modeled capacity row, internal_charge(axis,row) + external_charge(axis,row) == exactly_one.

future_model_freeze_requirements.technology: one exact foundry or calibrated memory-model identity shared by all axes
future_model_freeze_requirements.geometry: capacity organization and banking, including the 93-equivalent known geometry and separately labeled 24448-byte conservative residual
future_model_freeze_requirements.ports: port count, read/write mode, data width, banking and arbitration identical across axes
future_model_freeze_requirements.timing: read/write latency, throughput, setup/hold interface and clock-domain assumptions identical across axes
future_model_freeze_requirements.area: one area coefficient/model identity; common area either added to all axes or excluded from all axes
future_model_freeze_requirements.energy: one read/write/leakage coefficient identity; actual axis access counts remain measured, not forced equal
future_model_freeze_requirements.traffic: cycle-addressed read/write/idle counts per storage class and axis

symbols.A_logic_axis: matched logic-only DC area including interface/adapter but zero storage macro area
symbols.A_ext_common: identical external capacity area charge, symbolic until model freeze
symbols.T_axis: joint address-timed RTL plus external-memory execution time
symbols.E_logic_axis: matched logic energy from sealed activity and PTPX
symbols.Nread_axis_k: actual address-timed reads for storage class k
symbols.Nwrite_axis_k: actual address-timed writes for storage class k
symbols.Eread_common_k: common per-read energy coefficient for class k
symbols.Ewrite_common_k: common per-write energy coefficient for class k

future_matched_aggregation_formulas.execution_time_axis: T_axis = joint_replay(axis_logic, identical_external_ports_and_latency, axis_actual_access_trace); do not add independently overlapped cycle totals
future_matched_aggregation_formulas.residual_rule: E_residual_common_model_axis is the same conservative model term in all axes or omitted symmetrically; it is never derived from invented live accesses.

future_matched_tool_flow: freeze one exact external common-memory model and independently hammer its identity and three-axis equality
produce matched candidate, strongest-zero and same-coordinate-bit logic-only RTL tops with zero internal storage macro instances under the same library, SDC, clock and debug policy
run matched DC and PT setup/hold for each logic-only top and report them as logic-only
replay cycle-addressed interface traffic jointly with the identical external port/latency model for all axes
generate matched SAIF and PTPX logic energy, then aggregate actual per-axis external accesses with the common coefficients
apply the no-double-count matrix and independently hammer area, timing, power, energy and ratio tables before citation
publication_safe_claim: On the frozen H67 four-bottleneck-Conv ten-sample CPU same-ledger replay, a 214912-byte identical external capacity charge exposes a 1.7591725402x raw CPU-model opportunity; logic-only and external-memory quantities remain separate until matched RTL and a sealed common-memory model are aggregated.
forbidden_claims: the 24448-byte conservative residual is live or instantiated storage
existing parent-macro-inclusive area plus an external parent charge is total area
external dynamic energy is identical when actual access counts differ
throughput/mm2, energy, power or paper-PPA-ready before matched aggregation
multiplication of the raw CPU ratio with C2, C3, Prosperity or another local ratio
